title: avenSANDBOX ships without the Mac test for now
quote: Don't test on the Mac for now.
means: aip-6fb1's checkpoint 4 passes its review gate on the proof that theOS's check gives the same result on GitHub's runner, inside the box in a cloud session and outside it, after three rounds whose findings are all fixed. Gate B passes for GitHub and the cloud. Running the box on Samuel's Mac (OrbStack, arm64) is deferred until he tries it, and pasting environment-setup.sh into the cloud environment waits until theOS is on main; both are written in aip-6fb1's deferred list. aip-6fb1 then does Learn.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-f20b that held
